## Vine Temptress (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
N Medium plant  
**Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +2  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+1 dodge, +2 Dex, +3 natural)  
**hp** 37 (5d8+15)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +3, **Will** +3  
**DR** 5/slashing; **Immune** plant traits; **Resist** cold 10, fire 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** slam +5 (1d4+1)  
**Special Attacks** detonate, energy drain (1 level, DC 16)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 13, **Dex** 15, **Con** 16, **Int** 10, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 19  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 16  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Skill Focus (Diplomacy), [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam).*  
**Skills** Diplomacy +12, Disguise +9 (+29 to appear as target’s race)  
**Languages** any one (see below)  
**SQ** custom made, tethered  


**Special Abilities**


**Custom Made (Ex)** Each vine temptress is spawned in response to a single humanoid creature and created only to attract it. It gains a +20 bonus on disguise checks to appear as a member of its target’s race, a +4 insight bonus on diplomacy checks against its target and the ability to speak one language of its target.  

**Detonate (Su)** As a full-round action, a vine temptress can explode in a violent burst of blinding energy. This kills the vine temptress and destroys its body, dealing 5d6 force damage to every creature in a 20 ft. radius and blinding them for 1d6 rounds. A DC 15 Reflex save halves this damage and negates the blinded condition. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Energy Drain (Su)** A vine temptress drains energy from a willing, living creature it lures into a prolonged act of passion with a duration of at least 1 minute. A creature cannot be subject to this energy drain more than once per day, regardless of how many acts of passion with the temptress it accepts.  

**Tethered (Su)** A vine temptress is connected to its creator by a thin, invisible, incorporeal cord, allowing it to move up to 100 feet per Hit Dice (500 feet for most vine temptresses) from the center of the clearing. The vine has AC 22 and 10 hit points. Severing the cord instantly kills the vine temptress, but doesn’t harm the attractor fungus.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any underground  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or colony (3-250)  
**Treasure** standard
